name: Hyperbeat USDT
oneLiner: hbUSDT is Hyperbeat's yield-bearing USDT vault token on HyperEVM, exposing holders to DeFi lending and strategy returns over Tether's underlying par.
collateral: USDT0 was the only enabled deposit token at the fixed HyperEVM review block; Hyperbeat's documentation also lists USDe and USR as broader or legacy vault inputs. Deposits enter a dynamic HyperEVM DeFi strategy allocation, so the current constituent mix is not represented by fixed authored weights. Direct USDT is not an accepted deposit asset.
pegMechanism: hbUSDT is a yield-bearing vault token over USDT strategy exposure; holders exit through Hyperbeat vault liquidity into USDT, while ultimate fiat par exit remains Tether's issuer route

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Hyperbeat documentation and Accountable transparency identify a dynamic yield strategy, but do not provide the complete inputs needed to assign a direct wrapper archetype. The tracked hbUSDT proxy was created in HyperEVM block 3270801 on 2025-05-02, which establishes its implementation boundary without overriding the inherited parent classification.
